title: Retool quickstart landing visual language and screenshots
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Goal: Refresh the Quickstart landing to increase new-user activation and reduce first-session confusion. Deliver a cohesive visual language for the hero, three step diagrams, and a library of product screenshots that can be reused across docs and marketing. Emphasis: clear call-to-action, mobile-first layouts, and accessible color contrast. Out of scope: full copy rewrite (handled by PM), deep engineering changes to backend routes. This ticket covers designs, annotated assets, and screenshot capture instructions for handoff to engineering and content.
deliverables: 3 hero variants (illustration-first, screenshot-led, minimal code focus)
Annotated screenshot library (desktop + mobile + compact) with blurring rules
Figma components and tokens exported to dev handoff file
Accessibility compliance checklist and contrast report
Design handoff package (assets + README + export presets)
A/B testing hypothesis and tracking suggestions for PM/Analytics
acceptance_criteria: Hero shipped as responsive component with two approved variants in Figma
Diagram system implemented as four reusable components with copy placeholders
At least 9 screenshots exported (3 sizes x 3 flows) with simulated data and no PII
Contrast ratios for key elements meet WCAG AA (>=4.5:1 for body text)
Handoff file includes PNG/JPEG/WebP exports and a spritesheet for the hero illustration
A design review by PM and accessibility engineer marked as 'approved' in comments
design_decisions: Illustration style: semi-isometric, soft shadows, 2-3 tone palette to balance playfulness with enterprise trust
Screenshot framing: prefer 3:2 crop for desktop hero, full-bleed for mobile hero, 16:9 for docs inline
Interaction affordance: use micro-animations (Lottie) for hero CTA on hover/focus — engineering to evaluate perf impact
Typography: system stack with fallback to Inter; avoid heavy display fonts in hero for readability
Color: primary accent muted teal for 'action' to maintain contrast against dark code panels
screenshot_guidelines: Use demo account seeded data; all user-identifying fields must be redacted or obfuscated
Enable dark and light theme captures where relevant; provide both as separate exports
Record short 6-10s screen capture for any animated interactions; export as GIF + MP4 for review
Annotate each screenshot with context (flow name, screen step, device size, export filename)
Compress exports to target file sizes: hero <200KB webp, inline docs <120KB webp where possible
Include alt text drafts for each screenshot in the handoff README
